USAspending API v2 bulk download, fetched 2026-09-22; FY2016, 554,171 awards. CAVEAT: business size is the contracting officer's determination on the base action, not an audited status.
The blank set-aside mark is 26% a single $3.0bn contract, which is why it is drawn amber. These eleven civilian departments are 8.5% of federal contract awards; Defense (68.6%) is
absent, so this is not federal procurement as a whole.
